caption: Housing Starts year-over-year growth (FRED HOUST, SAAR; vermillion, left axis) against the SPY price (blue, right axis), 1993–2026. The 2006-09 collapse (starts peaked in early 2006 and fell ~75% into 2009, leading the GFC) and the 2022-23 rate-shock contraction are the key episodes. HOUST is seasonally adjusted at source — the YoY change is shown as the primary growth signal. Shaded bands mark NBER recessions.
narrative_alignment_note: Hero shows YoY growth (never the raw SAAR level) with the 0% line and the housing episodes.
